<tool_call>
<function=generate_interactive_story>
<parameter=content>
In a world where humans and robots coexist, you are a peacekeeper on a critical mission. You've just received intel about a potential robot uprising. Do you (A) infiltrate the robot community to gather more information, or (B) report back to human headquarters to strategize a defense plan?
</parameter>
<parameter=question>
What is the name of the planet humans live on?
</parameter>
<parameter=choices>
["A) Earth", "B) Mars", "C) Venus", "D) Jupiter"]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
